notes:
- Account background: mid-sized B2B SaaS platform providing subscription billing tools. Heavy volume of email/tickets after releases. They want to cut agent TTR and automate triage.
- Primary ask: ticket and email summarization (one-sentence + 3-bullet highlights) + auto-tagging into Zendesk/Freshdesk macros/workflows. Also want agent-facing condensed context in sidebar (top 3 prior tickets + suggested macros).
- Requirements: <200ms target for sidebar summary retrieval; nightly batch summarization of backlog (50k tickets) with cost cap; must support canonical tags + multi-label taxonomy; prefer open-models but need on-prem for PII-heavy flows.
- From AE notes: "If we can push F1 to 0.85 for tagging with fallback to human-review, procurement proceeds." — decision-maker: Head of Support, Lena Ortiz.
- Technical: want webhook tool-calling to trigger macro updates and ticket field edits; Zendesk app vetting process required (security review + app manifest). Need SSO for admin and audit trail retention 7 years.
- POC specifics: SE provided batch ingestion script, anonymization step, and two model profiles (quantized L2 and full fp16). Running A/B: hosted Redwood API vs Dedicated private deployment in GCP VPC.
- Risks: spikes during release windows require autoscaling bursts; they stressed importance of graceful degradation (fallback to cached summaries + lower-cost model) to avoid timeouts in agent UI.
- Sales pitch angle: emphasize deterministic latency SLOs, model routing, and per-route cost analytics; offer audit log retention add-on.
- Stubs/links: Fireflies ff_20260219_4567, drive pricing deck, jira SUP-1329 for anonymization bug.
- Next: gather SOC2 docs, confirm Zendesk app timeline, decide on Dedicated vs Private by 2026-04 quarterly review.
use_case_summary: Ticket/email summarization + auto-tagging for Zendesk/Freshdesk workflows. Agent assist sidebar (fast context), automated macros via tool-calling, backlog nightly summarization, handling release-induced spikes.
requirements_detailed: latency: 150-250ms for sidebar queries; 500ms acceptable for worst-case
throughput: 200 reqs/sec during peak releases; nightly batch 50k tickets
accuracy: tag F1 >= 0.85 for primary taxonomies
data_handling: PII redaction prior to cloud processing; ability to run on-prem for sensitive queues
integrations: Zendesk apps, Freshdesk webhooks, SSO/SAML, KMS/HSM
preferred_models: open (quantized L2) for cost; fallback to fp16 for accuracy. Will test Redwood-verified variants.
competitive_landscape: Evaluating in-house + Zendesk native automation + third-party ML vendors. Concerned about vendor lock-in and app marketplace approvals.
sales_notes: Keep POC lightweight: deliver 7-day labeled sample, show autoscaling, deliver tagging dashboard. Offer cost model showing savings vs FTE.
customer_quotes: "We need summaries that our agents actually use — not fluff." — Lena Ortiz, Head of Support
"Zero-downtime during release spikes is non-negotiable" — VP Eng
internal_risks: POC shows lower tag precision on billing intents
Zendesk app approval could add 6-8 week delay
implementation_plan: Phase 1: 2-week POC ingest + model tuning. Phase 2: Zendesk app + webhook tool-calls. Phase 3: Dedicated capacity + rollout to 2 support queues.
